The $126.74-$222.59 range (tax-inclusive) is from MouseSavers' aggregation of Disney's own date-based calendar; the low end is consistent with the official pre-tax $119 figure (119 x 1.065 FL tax ≈ $126.74), which supports the figures, but the high end should be spot-checked on the official ticket calculator for a specific peak date.
